pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal shapes with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are smooth due to image resolution. Patch area is largest on the central flank, decreasing in size and increasing in density toward the posterior and lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank, showing high continuity with no visible breaks.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a short, uniform fringe along the upper neck and back. Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, vertical linear lesion or scar is present on the mid-flank. It exhibits high contrast against the surrounding pelage and features an irregular, elongated geometry.
